style: Documentary technical narrator. Tight pacing. Dry. No hype. Speak only the script.

lines.text: AI agents can call real tools. Peffle decides what they may execute.
A buyer wants headphones under 7,500 rupees. Peffle finds Halo ANC in policy and writes the cart.
The agent tries a 20 percent discount. Authority and budget exceeded. Peffle blocks it. Nothing executes.
